hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Winsorized Cubic Conviction under Industry (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Clips industry-level z-scores to [-2.5, 2.5] before cubing (power 3). Under Industry neutralization, larger sector groupings contain extreme z-scores (z=3.5 -> 42x weight) that inflated turnover to 53.69%. Winsorizing caps outlier weight spikes while preserving cubic conviction for 99% of equities, dropping turnover to ~36% and lifting Fitness past 1.10 with safe self-correlation <0.35.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-month secular demand expansions where suppliers consistently outperform expectations.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, industry); clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 3); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Quadratic Conviction under Industry (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Uses smooth quadratic conviction (power 2.0) under Industry neutralization. Squares z-scores instead of cubing them, naturally capping tail-weight volatility, lowering turnover to ~38%, and pushing Fitness over the 1.00 threshold.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during acute supply bottlenecks where customer price spikes flow directly to supplier margins.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Winsorized Power 2.5 under Industry (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines z-score clipping [-2.5, 2.5] with power 2.5 curvature under Industry neutralization. Balances non-linear customer shock sensitivity with tight turnover control (~37%) to ensure 8 PASS with low cross-portfolio correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden tech supply chain component shortages.
